comparison.objective: Assemble a mini chopper so its interlocks permit operation, then pulse it once; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequence multiple keyed parts, align and twist-lock bowl/lid components, then operate a control versus coaxial mandrel placement and hammering.
comparison.success_condition: Chopper correctly assembled, interlock satisfied, and one valid pulse completed without unsafe operation; no intentional component fracture.
comparison.reason: Tests keyed assembly and safety-interlock sequencing, not impact break-off or loose-debris recovery.
